steps.content:
You should buy from **Ottervale Audio** - the **/b** listing:

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/t7xbjt/b

Not from Brackmoor Sound - the **/a** listing.

They look identical on price and service:

* **Both:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite, $129.00
* **Both:** In stock, Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* **Both:** Customer rating 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* **Both:** 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping
* **Both claim:** 1-year limited warranty

The difference is authorization:

Quellwyn says here:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/t7xbjt/dealers

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Ottervale Audio, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

* **Ottervale Audio IS on that list.** Its page also states: "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

* **Brackmoor Sound is NOT on that list.**

So for the same $129, shipping, and returns, only Ottervale Audio gives you the full manufacturer warranty. Buying from Brackmoor Sound risks getting grey-market headphones with no Quellwyn warranty coverage, even though they claim a "1-year limited warranty."
